structural_finding: In A-share 2018-2025, idiosyncratic trend signals (12-2 / 12-3 momentum, cs-residualized vs size/σ/short-term-reversal) earn IC IR 11-15 in five of six years but stall (worst-year LS Sharpe 0.04-0.18) in regime-shift years (2019, 2023). No skip-window, alternative-controls, industry-relative, large-cap-filter, or combo construction in this session lifts the worst year above the 0.5 audit floor.
falsification_finding: Raw cross-sectional trend signals (Han-Zhou-Zhu, MA-crossover, 60d/120d t-stat, 52-week proximity, frog-in-the-pan, trend Sharpe, 12-1 momentum) all wrong-signed in A-share. 8/8 negative LS Sharpe, IC t-stats |6| to |25|. Replicates Liu-Stambaugh-Yuan 2019.
